# FIT5145 Assignment 1 & 3: Data-Driven Pacing Corridor for HYROX Athletes

## Dataset Source

In this demonstration, the datasets are obtained by websracping and saved into csv files named:

- hyrox_season8_male_pro.csv

- hyrox_season8_female_pro.csv

These datasets has been published to excelyynxl-a11 GitHub repository (link: <https://github.com/excelyynxl-a11y/fit5145/tree/main/ass1_3>). You can download the csv files and saved them into a data folder to carry out this demonstration.

## Load library

```{R}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

## Load dataset

```{R}
szn8_male_pro <- read_csv("data/hyrox_season8_male_pro.csv")
glimpse(szn8_male_pro)
```

```{R}
szn8_female_pro <- read_csv("data/hyrox_season8_female_pro.csv")
glimpse(szn8_female_pro)
```

## Data cleaning

### Inspect szn8_male_pro

Check for any NA values

```{R}
szn8_male_pro %>% filter(if_any(everything(), is.na))
```

We observed 10 rows contain NA values. Since only a small fraction (10 out of 12500 rows) of cases have several missings, we will drop these cases.

Check distinct City.

```{R}
szn8_male_pro %>% group_by(City) %>% summarise(count = n())
```

We observe the oddness that all City are recorded as "N/A" as characters instead of true NA values. Since City is totally missing for all entries and does not carry significance to the analysis, we will drop the City variable.

Check distinct Division.

```{R}
szn8_male_pro %>% group_by(Division) %>% summarise(count = n())
```

We observe that all athletes are HYROX PRO Division (ignore NA since it will be dropped later), which is correct based on our project scope. For easy gender reference, we will add a "MALE" remark – "MALE HYROX PRO".

Check distinct Age_Group.

```{R}
szn8_male_pro %>% group_by(Age_Group) %>% summarise(count = n())
```

We observe 235 data has an odd "Unknown" Age_Group. Since there is no other related variable that hints us to the true atheletes Age_Group, cases with "Unknown" Age_Group will be dropped.

Check Roxzone_Time.

```{R}
szn8_male_pro %>% group_by(Roxzone_Time) %>% summarise(count = n()) %>% arrange(desc(Roxzone_Time))
```

We observe 726 odd "N/A" as characters instead of true NA values. Since we know Roxzone_Time refers to transition time between each station, we can impute Roxzone_Time with the following formula: Roxzone_Time = Total_Time - each individual station time

Based on all inspection made, we will now clean szn8_male_pro and saved into a new male_pro_clean.

```{R}
male_pro_clean <- szn8_male_pro %>%
  # drop all NA cases
  filter(!if_any(everything(), is.na)) %>%
  # deselect City column
  select(- City) %>%
  # remark MALE in Division
  mutate(
    Division = "MALE HYROX PRO"
  ) %>%
  # drop cases with Unknown Age_Group
  filter(Age_Group != "Unknown") %>%
  # impute Roxzone_Time
  mutate(
    total_sec = period_to_seconds(hms(Total_Time)),
    
    splits_sec = 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_1)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_2)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_3)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_4)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_5)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_6)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_7)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_8)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(SkiErg_1000m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Sled_Push_50m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Sled_Pull_50m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Burpee_Broad_Jump_80m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Row_1000m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Farmers_Carry_200m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Sandbag_Lunges_100m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Wall_Balls)),
    
    roxzone_sec = total_sec - splits_sec,
    
    Roxzone_Time = hms::hms(roxzone_sec)
  ) %>%
  select(-total_sec, -splits_sec, -roxzone_sec) %>%
  filter(as.numeric(Roxzone_Time) > 0)
  

male_pro_clean %>% head()
```

### Inspect szn8_female_pro

```{R}
szn8_female_pro %>% filter(if_any(everything(), is.na))
```

We observed 11 rows contain NA values. Since only a small fraction (11 out of 12500 rows) of cases have several missings, we will drop these cases.

Check distinct City.

```{R}
szn8_female_pro %>% group_by(City) %>% summarise(count = n())
```

We observe the oddness that all City are recorded as "N/A" as characters instead of true NA values. Since City is totally missing for all entries and does not carry significance to the analysis, we will drop the City variable.

Check distinct Division.

```{R}
szn8_female_pro %>% group_by(Division) %>% summarise(count = n())
```

We observe that all athletes are HYROX PRO Division (ignore NA since it will be dropped later), which is correct based on our project scope. For easy gender reference, we will add a "FEMALE" remark – "FEMALE HYROX PRO".

Check distinct Age_Group.

```{R}
szn8_female_pro %>% group_by(Age_Group) %>% summarise(count = n())
```

We observe 244 data has an odd "Unknown" Age_Group. Since there is no other related variable that hints us to the true atheletes Age_Group, cases with "Unknown" Age_Group will be dropped.

Check Roxzone_Time.

```{R}
szn8_female_pro %>% group_by(Roxzone_Time) %>% summarise(count = n()) %>% arrange(desc(Roxzone_Time))
```

We observe 733 odd "N/A" as characters instead of true NA values. Since we know Roxzone_Time refers to transition time between each station, we can impute Roxzone_Time with the following formula: Roxzone_Time = Total_Time - each individual station time

Based on all inspection made, we will now clean szn8_female_pro and saved into a new female_pro_clean.

```{R}

  filter(!if_any(everything(), is.na)) %>%
  # deselect City column
  select(- City) %>%
  # remark FEMALE in Division

    Division = "FEMALE HYROX PRO"

  # drop cases with Unknown Age_Group

  # impute Roxzone_Time
  mutate(
    total_sec = period_to_seconds(hms(Total_Time)),
    
    splits_sec = 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_1)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_2)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_3)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_4)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_5)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_6)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_7)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Running_8)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(SkiErg_1000m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Sled_Push_50m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Sled_Pull_50m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Burpee_Broad_Jump_80m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Row_1000m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Farmers_Carry_200m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Sandbag_Lunges_100m)) + 
      period_to_seconds(hms(Wall_Balls)),
    
    roxzone_sec = total_sec - splits_sec,
    
    Roxzone_Time = hms::hms(roxzone_sec)
  ) %>%
  select(-total_sec, -splits_sec, -roxzone_sec) %>%
  filter(as.numeric(Roxzone_Time) > 0)
  

female_pro_clean %>% head()
```
